newsitem.title: BELGIUM: MG withdraws request for AGIV aquisition.
newsitem.headline: MG withdraws request for AGIV aquisition.

text.p: German engineering giant Metallgesellschaft AG (MG) has withdrawn a request filed with the European Commission for clearance of its planned aquisition of industrial group AGIV, a Commission official told Reuters.
MG withdraws request for clearance of AGIV deal =2
The deal was notified to the Commission on February 7, but last week MG announced it had decided not to proceed with the proposed acquisition of a 49.99-percent stake in the loss-making German firm.
Some analysts had expressed the view that MG's surprise decision might not have been final.

The Commission published a notice in the European Union's Official Journal dated February 15 asking interested third parties to comment on the proposed deal. It will soon publish another statement saying the notification has been withdrawn, the official said. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
